# Workshop Launchpad

> Free live online workshop "Build Your First AI Project in 60 Minutes" for final-year engineering students in India. Held online on Saturday, October 10, 2026, 2:00–3:00 PM IST. No prior AI experience needed. Registration is free and limited to 500 seats.
